name: Caramel Sauce
siboNotes: Traditional caramel made with sugar, cream, and butter is typically well-tolerated in small amounts. Avoid versions with high fructose corn syrup or inulin.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for FODMAP additives like inulin or high fructose corn syrup
Make homemade caramel with regular sugar, lactose-free cream, and butter for better control
Use sparingly as a drizzle rather than a heavy coating
Store-bought versions may contain thickeners - choose simple ingredient lists
nutritionalHighlights: High in simple sugars for quick energy
Contains some calcium from dairy components
Provides small amounts of vitamin A from butter
